changelog: Recent & Favorites Custom Session Management: Full support for renaming, editing details, and deleting sessions directly from the user interface
Sleek Quick-Action Card Controls: Direct inline '✏️ Edit' and '🗑️ Delete' buttons on each card alongside '★'/'☆' favorite toggles and 'Connect ➜'
Right-Click Context Menu & 3-Dot Options: Rich context menu with Connect, Rename Session, Edit Details, Add/Remove Favorite, and Delete Session actions
Tailored Dark Modal Dialogs: Beautiful centered dialogs for Rename, Full Edit (ID/Alias/Favorite), and Delete confirmation matching OpenDesk dark aesthetic
Persistent Configuration Storage: Atomic updates to ~/.opendesk/config.json with automatic 9-digit space formatting and whitespace sanitization
Real-Time Grid Reactivity: Immediate UI grid refresh on any rename, edit, or deletion without requiring app restart
Startup & Connect Crash Immunity: Thread-safe post_ui dispatch queue eliminating cross-thread Tcl mutations and ucrtbase.dll buffer overrun crashes
Seamless In-App Title Bar (CSD): Native dark-mode hover states for integrated minimize, maximize, and close controls
Discord-Grade 48kHz HD Audio Suite: Echo cancellation, noise suppression, AGC, VAD, and Push-to-Talk
Authenticode Signed Binaries: Digitally signed with SHA-256 and DigiCert RFC 3161 timestamps
